# Settings + per-screen persistence sweep. No audio required.
# B-028/B-023: per-skin config must survive screen hops. B-034: SOUND group gating.
settings open
shoot settings_open
settings close
# transport position cycle (B-022)
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=transport value=top
shoot settings_transport_top
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=transport value=off
shoot settings_transport_off
call ext.nothingness.setSetting name=transport value=bottom
# operating mode + variant
mode background
shoot settings_mode_bg
mode own
variant system
# screen hop: dot -> spectrum -> dot (B-028 per-skin persistence)
screen dot
settings open
shoot settings_dot
settings close
screen spectrum
screen dot
settings open
shoot settings_dot_after_hop
settings close
inspect
overflows

# Regression replay scripts

`drive.py replay <file>` runs each line as a `drive.py` invocation (blank lines
and `#` comments skipped; aborts on the first non-zero exit). These scripts
*drive* the app and dump state/screenshots — read the output (and the PNGs in
`.tmp/agent_shots/`) to judge pass/fail; `replay` itself does not assert.

```bash
export DRIVE_TARGET=linux   # or android
D=.claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py
$D replay tool/regression/smoke.txt
```

Scripts that need audio assume short test tones staged under `.tmp/` (generate
with the snippet in `docs/regression-testing-playbook.md` / prior sessions, or
`adb push` on Android). UI/state/layout scripts need no audio.

See `docs/regression-testing-playbook.md` for the full test table these cover.
